kind: ADDITIVE and IMMUTABLE. One sequential DAgger round replicating the JULY R2 PROTOCOL on the current V26 lineage. rev4b, rev4c, rev4d, their addenda, receipts and reports are NOT mutated

MANDATORY_DECLARATIONS.a_multivariate_protocol_replay: THIS IS NOT A ONE-VARIABLE EXPERIMENT. Against rev4c FOUR dimensions change together: (1) init and anchor move from S1A to REV4C (sequential round), (2) the trace pool becomes cumulative (two traces instead of one), (3) interpolation_steps 0 -> 2, (4) trace_repeat 4 -> 1. It is a replication of the July R2 PROTOCOL, not a causal attribution
MANDATORY_DECLARATIONS.b_attribution_limits: A SUCCESS DOES NOT ATTRIBUTE CAUSALITY TO THE INTERPOLATION: with four simultaneous changes no single mechanism can be credited, exactly as July R2's own 356 steps remain unattributable. A FAILURE CLOSES the current R2-analogous direction
MANDATORY_DECLARATIONS.c_split_leakage_is_expected: interpolation produces 3 DISTINCT BUT CORRELATED rows per visited row, lying on the segment between the teacher state and the visited state and carrying the SAME label. adapt_actor draws the validation split as a seeded random permutation over the aggregate, so about 88 of the 184 visited-row groups will have correlated rows on both sides. VALIDATION MSE IS DIAGNOSTIC ONLY and is never a promotion criterion. Note: trace_repeat 1 removes EXACT-duplicate leakage only when interpolation_steps is 0, as in rev4d
MANDATORY_DECLARATIONS.d_known_risk_of_the_drifted_band: the July report states the interpolation was designed to teach local invariance to SMALL deviations. Measured L2 drift between the visited state and the teacher state at the same index: S1A rows 1-68 mean 10.134 (the band already consumed by rev4c), REV4C rows 69-116 mean 22.267, i.e. 2.2x larger, with 13 REV4C steps exceeding even the reference band's maximum of 30.229 and 68.1% of REV4C steps above the reference mean. The 69-116 band is therefore OUTSIDE the documented design intent of the mechanism. This converges with July R3's recorded lesson (adding the 356-row trace regressed 356 -> 221, 'distribuzioni sempre piu ampie') and with rev4d, which found S1A's drifted rows harmful at any weight. The risk is accepted knowingly and metrics are reported per band
